description:
About the team:

The Creation Experience team builds tools that enable our merchants to design and launch products. Simplicity and productivity are embodied in the solutions we deliver, empowering merchants to express their creativity and build great items. We are creating a one-stop solution where they can craft beautiful designs and seamlessly add them to our product catalog.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Back-End Software Engineer with expertise in TypeScript and Node.js to join the team. As a senior back-end engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering a scalable, robust solution. You will also use AI tools every day to build, test, and ship faster while maintaining a high bar for quality. This is not a back-end-only role: with AI tools at hand, we expect back-end engineers to take on simple front-end tasks when an initiative requires them.

A passion for writing and improving clean code and systems, being a collaborative team player, sharing knowledge, and humbly learning from others are essential to succeed in this position. Developing in this role will allow you to grow and advance within the company.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Taking responsibility for the design and execution of your own initiatives.

    • Every team member owns the full discovery and grooming process for their initiatives and drives them end-to-end, including full-stack changes and architectural decisions that reach beyond our team.

  • Identifying areas for improvement in the codebase and contributing to making it better.

  • Pairing frequently with teammates to give and receive feedback through code reviews to boost knowledge-sharing, learning, and platform improvement.

  • Using AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (writing code and tests, debugging, reviewing, and exploring unfamiliar code), while taking full ownership of the quality and security of what you ship.

  • Fixing prioritized bugs and issues tracked within the platform.

  • Participating in sprint demos, monthly team learning days, company-wide tech demos, and BE guild meetings.

  • Developing your soft skills and spending time discussing best practices and technologies, including new AI tools and techniques, with your peers.

Your qualifications:

  • 6+ years of commercial experience as a Software Engineer.

  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Node.js.

  • Solid experience with TypeScript and NestJS.

  • Experience with Rust.

    • Part of our image upload, template, and text-rendering code is written in Rust, and you will implement new features and review changes there.

  • Experience with PHP (nice to have).

  • Experience designing and implementing REST APIs.

  • Experience with microservice architectures.

  • Experience with AWS or at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).

  • Experience with software testing.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

  • Practical, everyday use of AI-assisted development tools, with a critical eye for reviewing AI-generated code.

  • Willingness to take on simple front-end tasks with the help of AI tools.

  • Fluency in English (both spoken and written).


Our tech stack:

  • TypeScript, NodeJS, NestJS.

  • Rust, PHP.

  • Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack.

  • PostgreSQL, MongoDB, messaging platforms.

  • AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Git, Postman.

  • Jest for testing

  • Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack.

  • Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment.

What we offer:

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

AS Printful Latvia (Reģ. Nr. 40203050078)
